hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-light text-stone-900 leading-tight

rules: Always use tracking-tighter for massive headings to ensure a premium editorial look.
Use Playfair Display for a luxurious, narrative feel against the aggressive sports imagery.
Use stone-50 (FAFAF9) as the absolute baseline background.
Accent color is a rich Amber/Bronze (B45309) to contrast beautifully against beige and signify premium sports.
Text should be stone-900 or stone-600, never pure black (#000000).

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards; pill-shape (rounded-full) for buttons

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white transition-colors duration-300. Secondary uses bg-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-200 text-stone-900.
components.cards: Flat white background (bg-white), subtle border (border-stone-100), ambient shadow. Internal padding must be generous (p-8 or p-10).
components.inputs: Shadcn input customized: bg-stone-50 border-stone-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-700/20 focus:border-amber-700 rounded-xl.
components.navigation: Sticky top header using Crystal Glassmorphism. Must have logo, 4 links, and a CTA button. Links must have explicit hover colors (hover:text-amber-700).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Luxurious breathing room. Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For Events/Services: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Avoid full screen dark overlays. Use a split layout (Text left, Image right) or a very light gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-stone-50 to-transparent) over a hero image.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward translation (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1).
motion.hover_effects: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Images inside cards scale up smoothly (scale-105) on group-hover.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Amber-700 against white passes comfortably.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-700 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

pages_structure.name: Home
sections: Hero: Massive typography, subtle beige background, overlapping premium sports imagery.
Marquee: Editorial ribbon of event names (Wimbledon, FIFA, Tomorrowland) moving slowly.
Bento Grid: Highlights of top 3 events and 1 key service.
Testimonial/Trust: Logos of partners or trust metrics.

pages_structure.name: Events
sections: Masonry/Grid: Large cards for Football, Tennis, NBA, Cricket, Tomorrowland with high-quality imagery.

pages_structure.name: Services
sections: Feature Blocks: Alternating left/right text-image blocks for Tickets, Flights, Accommodation, Visas.

pages_structure.name: About
sections: Story: Two-column layout with luxurious lifestyle imagery.
Values: Minimalist 3-column grid highlighting expertise, access, and support.

pages_structure.name: Contact
sections: Split Layout: Left side contact info and beautiful image; right side Shadcn Lead Capture Form (Name, Email, Phone, Event Interest, Message).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Shadcn card styles blindly. Follow the 'cards' instruction: flat white, subtle stone border, huge padding.
CRITICAL: No generic blue colors. Primary brand color is Amber-700 (#B45309). Backgrounds are stone-50 (#FAFAF9).
CRITICAL: Must implement React Router for the 5 pages (/ , /events, /services, /about, /contact) with a shared Layout component (Navbar + Footer).
CRITICAL: Header MUST use glassmorphism and sticky positioning.
CRITICAL: Apply data-testid to every interactive element.
CRITICAL: Use Framer Motion for page transitions and scroll-triggered animations.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use pure black backgrounds or text.
CRITICAL: Implement a fully working multi-page application with valid navigation links.
CRITICAL: Use .js extensions for components, not .tsx. You are operating in a React JS environment.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
